pre_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins" "${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins"; do [ -n "$d" ] || continue; for f in "$d/hooks/guard_hook.py" "$d"/*/hooks/guard_hook.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; done; done; echo "[guard] 未找到 guard_hook.py，已跳过拦截；请设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT" >&2; exit 0

post_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins" "${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins"; do [ -n "$d" ] || continue; for f in "$d/hooks/guard_audit.py" "$d"/*/hooks/guard_audit.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; done; done; echo "[guard] 未找到 guard_audit.py，已跳过审计；请设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT" >&2; exit 0
